answers.NAME: Agentic Bootstrap
answers.PURPOSE: Single-file scaffold that hands AI coding agents a disciplined workflow.
answers.RUN: python scripts/lint_bootstrap.py; open docs/index.html for the landing-page preview.
answers.EXTRA: The bootstrap file IS the artifact; modify only via deliberate PRs that bump the bootstrap-version header. The lint script at scripts/lint_bootstrap.py validates four cross-reference invariants and runs in CI on every PR.

best_practices_status.note: Hand-written for markdown-content discipline. The bootstrap doesn't yet ship a Markdown variant — see .docs/todos/markdown-content-best-practices-variant.md (paired with .docs/todos/expand-q4-language-coverage.md). The current .agents/rules/best-practices.md is the seed for that future variant.

self_application_note: This bootstrap.json was written during the project's own self-application. Sacred files (README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, LICENSE, SECURITY.md, CHANGELOG.md) pre-existed with hand-written content and were skipped per the Sacred re-run policy applied to a first-time run. .claude/settings.json was written without the Python language addendum per LANG=Other; the follow-up at .docs/todos/extend-claude-allow-list-with-python.md tracks adding the Python commands manually.
